_what: How a page is acted on from the person's browser (extension/src/page-actions.mjs). An action is a row in `actions`: its `op` is one of the primitive operations the page engine knows (click, set_text, key, scroll, select, focus, hover), with its own options; a new action over those primitives is a new row. A target is found by `match` (field: text or { equals | contains | starts_with | regex }) over the fields in `fields`, each read from the element in the order listed. Values on elements whose input type is in `withhold_values_from_types` are never used as fields or returned by a snapshot; other visible labels and configured value fields remain available. A target that matches more than one visible element needs an `nth`; none is a refusal, never a guess. Text is written through the control's value (or textContent for editable text), never as markup. A target `{ ref }` names an element from the last `snapshot`. `refuse_types` separately lists input types the engine will not write into; it is empty, so writes remain open by default. `dry_run` locates every target and acts on none.
candidates: a[href], button, input, select, textarea, summary, label, [role], [tabindex], [contenteditable], [onclick], [draggable], [aria-label]

hover.what: Rest the pointer on an element.

focus.what: Put the cursor in an element.

type.what: Write text into a field or editable area, replacing what it holds.

append.what: Add text after what a field holds.

select.what: Choose an option of a menu by its visible text or value.

press.what: Press a key (Enter, Escape, Tab, ArrowDown, a letter) in an element or in the page.

scroll.what: Scroll the page, or an element, by pixels.

fill.what: Write text into a field, replacing what it holds (the same as type).

drag.what: Press on one element, move to another and let go (to: the other element, found the same way).

snapshot.what: List what can be acted on, each with a ref a later step can name as target { ref }; the refs last until the next snapshot.

words.unknown_action: This page engine has no action named {action}.
words.too_many: More than {max} steps in one run.
words.ambiguous: {count} elements matched {target}; say which with nth (0 to {last}).
words.bad_nth: nth must be a whole number from 0 to {last}.
words.refused_type: Writing into a {type} field is turned off in this browser's settings.
words.not_writable: That element is not something text can be written into.
words.bad_ref: No element has the ref {ref}; take a snapshot again.
words.gone_ref: The element with the ref {ref} is no longer on the page; take a snapshot again.
words.needs_to: {action} needs to: the element to drop on.
